observations: Azhdari-Zarmehri et al., Basic and Clinical Neuroscience; tested termination of formalin phase-2 nocifensive behavior and opioid involvement.

entities.name: Formalin phase-2 termination
observations: In the study, repeated 2% formalin (50 μL) at a 60-minute interval diminished nociceptive behavior; a 5-minute interval did not.
Naloxone 1 mg/kg reduced phase-2A nociception but did not alter delayed termination, consistent with an endogenous inhibitory mechanism other than opioid receptor activation in this protocol.
